name: DPM++ 3M SDE
plain: Extends the multistep SDE to two previous x0 values for a third-order correction, building up from first to second order over the early steps. One model call per step, Brownian noise.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
λ=half-logSNR, h, h_η, α' as in 2M SDE. x'=(σ'/σ)e^{−hη}x+α'(1−e^{−h_η})D.
φ₂=(e^{−h_η}−1)/h_η+1, φ₃=φ₂/h_η−½.
Two histories: r₀=h₁/h, r₁=h₂/h; d₀=(D−D₁)/r₀; d₀₁=(D₁−D₂)/r₁; d₁=d₀+(d₀−d₀₁)r₀/(r₀+r₁); d₂=(d₀−d₀₁)/(r₀+r₁); x'+=α'φ₂d₁−α'φ₃d₂.
One history: x'+=α'φ₂(D−D₁)/(h₁/h).
Noise: x'+=n(σ,σ')σ'√(1−e^{−2hη})s_noise.

props.flow_const: half-logSNR via sigma_to_half_log_snr: λ=−log σ normally, λ=log((1−σ)/σ) on CONST; α=σe^{λ} (1 normally, 1−σ on CONST). First σ≥1 on CONST replaced by percent_to_sigma(1e-4); s_noise×noise_scale.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Same algorithm; the _gpu name differs only by building the BrownianTreeNoiseSampler with cpu=False, so the noise tensor values differ for one seed. Node has eta, s_noise, noise_device; gpu listed first.
